name: instance-model-editor-layout-phone
description: InstanceSheet per-model settings 360px phone geometry: inside .fieldInline, .fieldGrow stretches the Input up to the Reset link button; inside .modelRow, .modelNameSlot wraps a long unbroken model ID without pushing .modelMeta past the 360px sheet row.

mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-12: without flex: 1 1 0 on .fieldGrow, inputWidth shrinks to 256px inside the 314px .fieldInline row (slack=8.22px), failing the [-1, 2] slack bound.
